spec.title: PROP-072 — Explicit source interpretation and admission

p.SOURCE-DESCRIPTOR-GRAMMAR: A package or opt-in project source row selects exactly one portable relative file or directory default. Media, interpretation, role and loading are explicit and validated together. Native Vibe spec, Vibe documentation, ordinary CommonMark, XML data and opaque resources are distinct interpretations; no authored trust field exists. Host observations and byte witnesses are separate from authored intent. Generated boot publication artifacts belong to the shared layout owner, never authored source rows or inherited directory defaults. Declaration admission additionally refuses ASCII case aliases derived from those same canonical paths and publication prefix. Exact materializer payload ownership is unchanged: rejecting a portable declaration alias does not claim that spelling is generated on Linux. Broader filesystem alias qualification remains separate.

p.SOURCE-DESCRIPTOR-PRECEDENCE: Exact file overrides directories; otherwise the longest component-delimited directory wins. Equal identical rows coalesce; equal incompatible rows return path-specific NeedsInput with original row indexes. No match is unclassified. Coordinate plus original relative path identifies the resource independently of suffix, output format or physical bytes. Package Simple/Normal and boot linkage do not follow from descriptor interpretation.

p.SOURCE-PACKAGE-OPT-IN: Presence of package sources or source_exports opts into classification, including explicit empty lists. Absence of both retains legacy package behavior; explicit policy without source rows grants zero semantic sources. An empty export list does not remove separately declared source rows. Typed parsing/serialization preserves this distinction and present null refuses. Unmatched files remain raw. Source exports select ordinary CommonMark sections only through the captured resolver; export-only presence grants no implicit semantic sources and cannot restore legacy scanning. Opt-in project sources follow SOURCE-HOST-POLICY; source_exports remain package-only.

p.SOURCE-ADMISSION-BOUNDARY: A root-aware consumer observes the caller-selected logical root, admitted physical root identity and exact manifest bytes through held no-follow source reads. MissingManifest is unclassified content-tree compatibility, not proof of legacy package policy. Present malformed or unreadable manifests refuse. Before publication the same logical root and manifest must still agree, including missing becoming present; rereading a detached old root alone is insufficient. Admitted source reads may use the same held root capability. Held observations retain the root capability for actual source reads. Guard-only scans consume them into detached checkpoints with no file descriptor or source-read capability; checkpoints transiently re-admit logical roots and compare observed identity/manifest bytes. They preserve ordinary replacement, alias retarget and missing-to-present detection, but do not retain an old handle to exclude inode-reuse ABA. Neither form claims whole-world atomicity, authentication or content CAS. Declared inputs enter only a classified supported consumer or a precise pre-effect unsupported-operation refusal; they never silently fall back to suffix semantics. ExplicitEmpty means empty semantics rather than a fabricated parse failure. Pure specdoc projection performs no manifest/root discovery.

p.SOURCE-MIGRATION-REPLAY: The finite source-boot-normal-absent-r1 to source-boot-normal-declared-absent-r1 transition recognizes one explicit normal flow boot source and preserves every existing byte while inserting one source row through the existing M13 token replay owner. It asks for media independently of suffix, accepts only the exact matching explicit Vibe spec answer, and revalidates the target. Reserved output paths refuse before an impossible media question. Identity profiles reject unused decisions. Original C2 request answers bind validation and existing D1 replay/application; no new writer or journal exists. Repeated apply and stale-source refusal require actual integration evidence. This does not classify all historical shapes or implement downstream boot/transform consumers.

p.SOURCE-OBSERVATION-LAW: A declared document reader first selects its source row and media over one held source byte observation. Only a supported native interpretation may invoke a normative Vibe parser or produce native facts. Ordinary CommonMark has a separate inert structural reader. CommonMark, XML-data, opaque and unmatched inputs remain non-native/raw; ambiguous, absent or invalid declared input cannot mint facts. Row identity and bytes/provenance remain separate; authored rows grant no trust. Exact-file facts adoption uses lock-selected identity and original Mixed slot record consistency, and refuses unsupported census/transformed or rederive paths before registry writes. The current facts-adopt path binds lock-selected kind/group/name/version and independently selected content hash to a captured original Mixed slot record, its manifest and exact declared document bytes through retained workspace/slot capabilities. The shared record validator rejects transformed metadata in Mixed records. Recorded manifest drift cannot be hidden by deleting source declarations; unrecorded legacy slots retain their separately qualified compatibility. The selected workspace, slot, registry-directory identity, lock, record and document bytes are rechecked before registry publication. Effective Mixed rederive admission happens before upserts and retains its no-op decision; predictable transformed/config refusal never follows successful registry mutation. Editable hashes prove consistency only, not authenticated original-source correspondence. Whole-change atomicity, hostile ABA and uncooperating writers remain outside this finite observation guarantee.

p.SOURCE-INSTALL-BOUNDARY: Installation admits the complete selected source-policy set, including exact declared input availability and selection/census support through the materializer's shared admission owner, before metadata publication, lifecycle execution publication, deferred in-place placement, hooks or slot writes. The outer coordination lease precedes authoritative snapshots: its empty lifecycle.lock and an empty allocated run-identity directory may remain after refusal; this is not permission for manifest, dependency lock, slot, facts or handler effects. Known supplied manifest policy governs even when the content directory lacks a local manifest; absence cannot erase a declaration. The bounded initial route supports original Mixed materialization with no declared own boot inputs; transformed/in-place/declared boot consumers refuse specifically before effects. Ordinary legacy dependencies do not by themselves make a declared package unsupported. Captured full manifest meaning, not only package metadata, must match the admitted input at the copy boundary. Generated boot ownership remains the exact G3 predicate; declaration alias refusal is a separate portable admission rule. The shared SourceObservation value carries bytes, permissions and file identity measured through the same held source read; it retains no per-file descriptor and is not an ownership receipt. Closing length/mode/identity checks include readonly state on supported hosts. Captured Mixed Copy uses those bytes and permissions; Hardlink stages the existing link attempt and verifies candidate identity, bytes and mode before destination replacement, with captured-byte/mode Copy fallback. Source identity/bytes/permissions are rechecked before reconcile; no chmod mutates a shared source inode. Known-declared input admission is finite, not a whole-world snapshot: changes after it can still cause ordinary partial failure. The slot record remains bytes-only; permissions participate in observed recorded-file reconciliation and placement, not authenticated metadata recording. Incumbent byte-matching unrecorded occupants remain untouched; this does not promise to repair foreign permission modes. This remains finite source observation and bounded publication, not authentication, hostile-ABA exclusion or unconditional content CAS.

p.SOURCE-COMMONMARK-STRUCTURE: The ordinary CommonMark view is a pure structural reading of the exact supplied UTF-8 source, using one standard CommonMark grammar with tables. It exposes headings, sections, fences and links without producing Vibe facts, directives or execution. Vibe-shaped words and heading annotations remain ordinary text. Source ranges refer to original bytes, not normalized Vibe projection positions. Container boundaries, setext headings, inline image/code text and nested fences require explicit executable cases; a section must not silently swallow unrelated text after its container closes. Node indices are local to a document snapshot and never durable fact identities; checked lookup does not pretend to prove cross-document identity. Host source witnesses bind any externally navigable node reference. A selected range is an exact source slice, not a promise of standalone equivalent Markdown rendering.

p.SOURCE-EXPORT-SELECTOR: A package source export has one package-unique ASCII name matching [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]*, an exact portable authored source file and a nonempty root-to-section path of normalized visible heading titles. Core owns declaration grammar and duplicate names; the structural parser owns heading interpretation and exact selection. Equal sibling headings are ambiguous; no ordinal or first-match fallback is allowed. Source exports are declarations, not proof of file availability or source interpretation. The single package policy owner treats presence of sources or source_exports, including empty arrays, as explicit policy; export-only metadata grants zero implicit semantic sources and cannot restore suffix scanning. Null and unknown declaration members refuse. Absence of both fields preserves legacy behavior.

p.SOURCE-EXPORT-RESOLUTION: Named ordinary exports resolve through the descriptor-selected captured CommonMark observation. The join checks the selected resource and interpretation, the exact parsed source bytes and the existing SourceFileWitness; it returns export identity, source witness and document-local selection without minting normative facts or new authority. Core export-name/path validation and host source witnesses are reused rather than redefined inside the parser. Ambiguous, missing, malformed or unavailable structure yields a typed export failure while raw captured bytes remain readable. Ordinary structure failure does not invalidate unrelated native facts. A parser plus a declaration field alone is not delivery: actual captured Mixed installed source to export resolution is required.

p.SOURCE-DATA-INSPECTION-LAW: Opaque preservation and optional XML-data inspection borrow the exact caller-supplied bytes; raw retrieval never depends on decoding, structural success or a budget. Inspection is NotRequested, Available with a root lexical name and event counts/depth, or Unavailable with a typed reason. The optional UTF-8 XML 1.0 profile uses the existing quick-xml event, attribute and reference machinery, enables end-name/comment checks, rejects DTDs and external/unknown references, and performs no resolution, network, filesystem, provider or native Vibe interpretation. Explicit caller-provided input, depth, element and text-work budgets limit only optional inspection; no hidden global raw-source quota exists. Available is a non-validating event summary, not a DOM, full XML validity certificate, namespace proof, source identity or trust assertion. Unsupported encoding, malformed event structure and limits preserve all original bytes including BOM, comments and line endings. The summary counts non-declaration processing instructions as inert events without interpreting their target/content, attributes or URLs. Complete Name/QName and PI-target grammar and namespace bindings are not validated: malformed lexical names or reserved PI targets accepted by the upstream event reader may still yield Available. The declaration profile permits only an initial declaration after an optional UTF-8 BOM, version 1.0, optional UTF-8 encoding and standalone yes/no in standard order, using the upstream checked attribute iterator; duplicate/unknown fields and late declarations refuse. Text-work bytes count raw Text/CDATA payloads and reference spellings, including outside whitespace, but exclude attributes, comments, markup delimiters and BOM. Budgets are input bytes, nesting depth, element count, text-work bytes and non-EOF event count, each independently optional and explicitly supplied. They are not wall-time bounds. Inspection failure must not invalidate unrelated native facts. Actual A3 install/derive/read and selected installed boot-map integration remain separate obligations.

p.SOURCE-INSTALLED-READ-LAW: The workspace remains the sole installed-slot record parser and validator. It prepares source/output rows and opaque captured manifest/record bytes from held roots and independently selected package identity, source hash and materialized input format. The lower spec reader receives data, not a new filesystem grant or duplicated record parser. Actual reads bind the provided held slot to its policy checkpoint and compare metadata before and after reading the same output buffer against its recorded digest. Installed self slots are descendants, never newly canonicalized caller-root aliases. Complete selected coordinate/version sets are preserved; declared branches with absent required binding refuse rather than fall back to newest or suffix lookup. Pattern inventory must recheck its metadata even when no member matches. Original logical source, physical output path and native semantic address remain distinct. Declared media drives both Simple and Normal projection. Converted output witnesses do not prove original-file SHA or source authentication. Generated STATIC/substitution/replay inputs retain their separate incumbent artifact lane and never become authored descriptors or public source addresses. Generated bytes must be captured through the existing publication or validated-reuse owner before later consumption; topology-selected filenames and a digest computed after reading them are not by themselves that evidence. Reuse retains the incumbent INDEX fingerprint/pending and artifact-presence contract, without claiming cryptographic authentication of editable output. Prepared replay bytes retain their existing publication ownership. Only typed initial generated seeds use the artifact-stream projection path; ordinary reference admission runs before worklist cache reuse, including when a generated root was already resolved. Prior emitted framing remains observed prior data and cannot authenticate or remint current source/EmbedTape authority. Current attribution derives from the current compiler witness. Raw artifact bytes/digest stay distinct from canonical Markdown projection positions, which retain the XmlProjected diagnostic label without injecting prose into parsed text. Unit emission validates the independently selected source hash and read binding before reusable-artifact shortcuts. Prepared bindings contain a nonoptional source hash; a lost replay read context refuses even when a slot record still carries a hash. Bound analysis and backend overloads take selected materialized input format from the incumbent command selection owner. Legacy unbound wrappers retain legacy behavior and specifically refuse declared missing binding; unbound boot-graph verification cannot report a guessed declared fingerprint.

SOURCE-DECLARED-MATERIALIZATION.title: Declared native conversion and raw publication

p.SOURCE-DECLARED-MATERIALIZATION-LAW: Declared interpretation precedes conversion. Ordinary CommonMark, XML-data, opaque and unclassified resources retain original paths and bytes; only supported selected native source enters the incumbent converter by declared media. Original logical address comes from the original declared path, not a renamed output. Raw same-stem resources coexist, while actual output and native-address collisions refuse before metadata, earlier slots or hooks. Materializer-owned finite preparation supplies this decision; it is not an immutable global source census or transaction. Observed new/absent paths publish without replacement and refuse a newly appearing occupant; recognized recorded updates retain their existing cooperative law. Matching unrecorded occupants and shared inode permissions remain protected. Independently selected materialized input format is not inferred from STATIC suffix or slot record; boot rendering format is separate. Unsupported vocabulary or missing evidence is explicit. Directory defaults require an honestly scoped payload inventory, not a fabricated global completeness claim or permanent refusal inherited without review.

p.SOURCE-GENERATED-XML-PROJECTION-LAW: Generated-artifact projection is separate from authored single-document source parsing. The generated profile reads native Spec vocabulary roots, repeated declarations, outer framing, generated inner c1 events and incumbent hoisted comment/#use rows through the existing emitted-stream event owner and framing codec. Hoisted syntax belongs only to this projection profile; minifier acceptance and exact-byte deletion semantics remain unchanged. Each document enters the existing SpecDoc pivot and canonical Markdown writer; semantic generated events are placed through reader/writer mappings, never sentinel strings or escaped-text inference. Outer framing and hoisted rows retain their bytes, declarations are omitted as representation metadata, and canonical separators may be added. Ordinary inner comments remain layout under PROP-045; comment-consuming readers retain original bytes. Escaped prose, CDATA and fenced examples never mint generated events; the incumbent Markdown literal policy protects reserved-looking prose before real generated comments are inserted. Unknown vocabulary, malformed XML/framing, DTDs, unknown entities and genuinely unrepresentable semantic placements refuse explicitly, without a Normal-to-Simple fallback or silent loss. Required actual emitter-produced multiple-root, annotated and hoisted cases must work. The returned text is a projection; callers retain XML-projected kind and use the incumbent projection-relative diagnostic notice without adding prose to document content. The helper grants no filesystem, source-admission or public source-address authority, authenticates no editable artifact and supplies no original authored-file positions. Artifact identity and evidence remain separate caller obligations; arbitrary opaque post-emission rewrites are not promised to be projectable.

p.SOURCE-QUERY-READ-LAW: A requirements query of an explicitly classified installed package uses the existing workspace-prepared source binding and lower held reader. The independently selected package identity, version, source hash and materialized input format must agree with captured manifest, slot record and output bytes before facts are interpreted. The workspace remains the sole slot-record parser; facts receive existing lower-layer binding data, not a reverse workspace dependency. Facts obtain interpretation metadata from the binding attached to the same resolver that performs the reads; a detached binding cannot override that reader's classification. Original logical document paths determine fact addresses while witnesses describe the bytes actually observed; transformed output does not prove an original-file digest. Raw resources cannot mint native facts or compiler directives. The trusted CLI or MCP context supplies materialized input format through the existing configuration selection policy, never a public query argument or a value inferred from the slot record or generated STATIC suffix. Missing or inconsistent binding must produce the existing contract's truthful refusal or source state, not successful empty facts or a suffix fallback. Query preparation may defer native syntax interpretation to the facts observer while retaining all selected-identity, descriptor, path, record and byte-integrity checks. Native syntax or duplicate-fact failure on captured bytes yields the existing Invalid source state with its witnesses; failure to establish trustworthy binding or observation yields Unavailable without a fabricated observation digest. Malformed query-wide lock or registry state remains a typed query failure. Query grammar validation still precedes filesystem access; source reading remains read-only, without a lifecycle lease or implicit regeneration. Legacy package parsing, report grammar, relation-provider selection and observation identity retain their existing contracts. When a slot record is present, its selected identity and manifest witness must be coherent before compatibility fallback; incoherent recorded metadata is Unavailable. Unrecorded undeclared content-tree slots retain their explicit legacy route. Host source declarations and other consumer integrations are separate obligations of the same A4 task, not satisfied by this package-query join.

p.SOURCE-HOST-POLICY-LAW: Optional project.sources reuses the existing descriptor grammar and selector precedence. Absence preserves the explicit legacy host route; a present empty list selects empty semantics and cannot revive suffix scanning. Present null and unknown descriptor members refuse. Legacy constructors omit the field. Declaring rows does not invent package identity or impose a blanket project.group requirement; consumers that mint or resolve host spec addresses require the existing valid self coordinate. The held manifest observation and policy mode recognize host presence together with grammar activation. Each affected root-aware semantic consumer either uses declared selection or explicitly refuses before unsupported interpretation and relevant product mutation; package-only detection cannot silently ignore host intent. Generated publication artifacts remain separate from authored host sources. No synthetic installed slot record, package kind or original-content authentication is introduced for host trees.

p.SOURCE-HOST-SYNC-LAW: Host fact synchronization selects only the concrete native documents cited by existing host registry entries, preserving the established canonical document and anchor laws. Shared exact-file and directory-default precedence applies to candidate files; unrelated directory defaults do not invalidate a citation. A directory requested as content refuses, while an exact regular file selected through a directory default is supported by bounded held candidate resolution, not a whole-tree semantic census. Raw same-stem resources do not own native addresses. Real ambiguity, raw-only selection, unavailable file, malformed native syntax or unsupported vocabulary refuses before registry writes. Only a missing anchor or no-longer-marked fact in a successfully admitted and parsed native document permits the existing removal tie-break; missing or reclassified source is not semantic deletion. Capture all cited bytes through the existing no-follow source reader, retain source identity and manifest checks, and validate/recheck the finite cited inputs before the first registry update. A later invalid citation must leave both disk and in-memory registry unchanged. Uncited malformed files are not parsed. Existing status and void semantics and shared regular inode support are preserved. No citations retains the existing read-free no-op. This is prevalidation under the existing cooperative publication law, not a new registry transaction or hostile compare-and-swap guarantee.

SOURCE-HOST-READ.title: Captured declared host reads through existing consumers

p.SOURCE-HOST-READ-LAW: Declared native host lookup uses the existing resolver and SectionSource with the caller-selected host root, held manifest policy and captured original bytes/media. Match the actual consumer coordinate to the resolver self coordinate before addressed interpretation; preserve existing versioned-self refusal, canonical aliases, anchor selection, revision-pin transport and caller-root alias rules. Section reading does not add a revision-equality validator. Installed selected/self slots remain on their independently bound installed path and cannot become host inputs merely because a directory has a manifest. Do not fabricate a slot record, resolved package, package kind, source hash or spec coordinate for host reads. Reuse the shared selector and finite cited-source capture/recheck; ordinary data cannot acquire a native address through its suffix, matching anchor text or custom frontend fallback. Byte/media/identity observations must remain coherent through read and cache reuse. An overlay is accepted only when tied to the admitted observation or explicitly refused, never silently replaced by disk after failure. Keep projection kind and original logical path distinct from physical source spelling and canonical projected positions. Add host support through the existing SourceLocation/reader dispatch; old path-only consumers must not gain unchecked interpretation as a side effect. Broad inventory and own-boot consumers reuse this foundation in later A4 slices.

p.SOURCE-OPERATION-ENROLLMENT-LAW: Source loading distinguishes automatic discovery from explicit selection; it is not a universal prohibition on observing raw bytes. Scan may enumerate any declared interpretation, but only admitted native interpretations supply native meaning. A requested native address or citation may select native scan or explicit input. Requested facts/adopt/query observation retains native explicit and may witness classified ordinary bytes without parsing them as facts or managed directives. A named ordinary resource/export request or a skill.resource declaration is explicit selection and preserves literal data. Automatic own-boot discovery selects VibeSpec instruction sources with scan loading only within the existing boot scope; native explicit is not automatically enrolled and ordinary scan never enters managed compiler input. Explicit package boot_snippet/source bindings retain their separate explicit-selection law. Existing own-host Simple semantics and HostUngrouped provider identity remain; no project.format, invented group, new resource URI or transport follows from this rule.

p.SOURCE-HOST-INVENTORY-LAW: Requested host facts/query observation enumerates exact source rows and only the declared directory scopes through the existing held root and shared selector. Capture all selected bytes and witnesses before native interpretation, then recheck finite selected membership, policy, parent and file observations before returning a result. This is a declared source inventory, not a global repository census or copied publication payload rule. Generated outputs retain incumbent ownership exclusions. Directory traversal explicitly excludes .git VCS control entries; an exact declaration requesting that reserved control subtree refuses rather than disappearing from a complete result. This does not exclude .gitignore, .github, arbitrary dot directories or build directories by heuristic. Nested manifest files within the explicitly selected outer scope do not switch policy, import identity or create new scan roots; apply the selected outer descriptors to them as to other bytes. Do not fake package metadata or use a child manifest's kind to authorize outer native vocabulary. An actual materialized root still requires the independently bound installed route. Requested observation preserves native explicit as well as scan and may witness ordinary bytes without minting facts/directives. Use the existing direct native AST parser and actual self coordinate. Complete native syntax/duplicate failures produce Invalid with captured witnesses; unavailable or untrustworthy census/read produces Unavailable without a fabricated digest. With a valid selected self coordinate, explicit empty is Available with zero facts; no group is invented for a query lacking identity. Malformed query-wide lock/registry remains an error. Preserve legacy and installed-package behavior, report digest recipes and grammar-before-I/O/read-only operation. Exact cited sync retains its narrower cited set and cannot be poisoned by uncited bad files.

SOURCE-HOST-BOOT.title: Declared authored node boot selection and publication

p.SOURCE-HOST-BOOT-LAW: Automatic authored node boot selects immediate children of the existing boot directory through the shared outer source policy. Enroll instruction sources with VibeSpec interpretation and scan loading; ordinary, documentation and native explicit-only sources are not automatically enrolled. Exact declared immediate eligible files participate even when absent so a missing promised boot input refuses. Generated STATIC/INDEX and owned publication controls retain their separate ownership. Preserve original paths, existing category/order rules and actual own/inherited Dynamic linkage with Simple format; unconditional INDEX static read-kind does not mean compiler static linkage. Do not add project.format or force Normal/STATIC compilation. Use narrow held original-resource capture for the selected boot scope, not whole-host inventory and not a fabricated group, package or installed record. Ungrouped nodes use their incumbent HostUngrouped provider without minting spec addresses. The private prepared-node carrier retains entries with observed policy/media/bytes; early source admission and authoritative generation share its selection logic. Validate every known node before earlier metadata/package effects, then recheck relevant captured input immediately before actual INDEX/redirect publication, including zero-static, managed-native and replay routes. Only an actual compiler path consuming a node input may claim captured-media compiler coverage; normal own enrollment is proved by INDEX and original bytes. Unrelated invalid or missing sources outside selected automatic boot scope cannot poison this operation. Existing exact native lookup remains available for explicit-only sources. This is finite prevalidation/recheck under existing cooperative publication, not a new global transaction or source-authentication claim.

p.SOURCE-BOOT-CHECK-LAW: The bound boot-graph verifier uses independently selected materialized SpecFormat, existing durable resolution, prepared source bindings, mapped unit table and format-aware owner-plan fingerprints. The old unbound wrapper retains its legacy contract and cannot guess declared input format. Reuse the incumbent fingerprint/pending/stale propagation owner; this is not STATIC-body authentication or generated-input consumption admission. The actual check command selects format through the existing project/operator configuration owner. An absent durable lock makes this adapter non-applicable without loading irrelevant configuration or creating state. A present malformed, nonregular or unreadable installed scope is not absence. An applicable graph that cannot be loaded, bound or verified produces the existing BootGraphIntegrity Error through the normal report and error exit; it must not silently contribute no findings. Stale or missing unit INDEX remains the incumbent Warning and warning-only exit behavior. Do not add a CheckId, schema, CLI option, lifecycle lease, regeneration or new member-discovery semantics. Other authored/project check rules retain their own scope.

SOURCE-FACT-COMMANDS.title: Selected package facts report and adoption

p.SOURCE-FACT-COMMANDS-LAW: Package facts report/adopt use the existing independently selected lock identity/hash and effective materialized format with the sole workspace record preparation and installed observer. Recorded directory selections and supported transformed representations retain original logical addresses and direct native meaning; do not force Mixed solely to read or fabricate PackageMeta/record/hash. Report is read-only and distinguishes unavailable/invalid authored totals from a genuinely unmaterialized package or zero facts. Adopt adds only requested marked missing entries, respects prefix, preserves existing entries and void semantics, and checks selection/policy/source/destination before writes. For transformed adoption, prepare exact offline locked source, configuration and prospective overlay conversion through existing owners before first registry upsert; known unsupported conversion/collision or missing source/config cannot first appear after registry mutation. Preflight itself never publishes materialization or a temporary registry. After additions execute the real retained rederive with the same selection/format, preserving overlay application. Shared workspace slots retain their workspace-root registry overlay owner. A member adoption changes its selected local registry but does not silently make shared slots member-owned: preflight and execution use the same workspace overlay, with prospective additions only when that is the registry actually being changed. Retain/recheck the consumed overlay input; do not reject an otherwise supported member operation solely to avoid this distinction or claim per-member materialized views. Original package hash, materialized file witnesses, exact persisted registry overlay hash and derived payload hash keep distinct meanings; no source hash is added to FactEntry and no guessed prospective hash replaces persisted bytes. Late I/O/concurrent failure retains named existing partial-failure behavior, not a new global transaction claim. Clean legacy and existing Mixed no-op remain compatible; declared in-place without an actual binding owner is an explicit provenance limitation, never forged authority.

SOURCE-DOC-POINT.title: Captured citation and agent document reads

p.SOURCE-DOC-POINT-LAW: Citation resolution and agent page reads consume captured native bytes and declared media through the existing SpecSources selection chain. Preserve checkout, in-tree, lock and store precedence; a genuinely absent selection may advance, but a selected invalid lock binding cannot become a store fallback. An installed declared source uses independently selected full lock identity/hash and materialized input format through the existing workspace preparation and bound reader. Authored originals use held manifest policy and actual coordinate; relocated derived slots cannot masquerade as authored roots. Retain original logical relative paths independently of physical converted names and suffixes. Parse the captured Spec or Doc AST directly and recheck the selected observation before returning content. Only an actual Doc package grants documentation vocabulary; ordinary resources remain literal and cannot acquire native meaning through an anchor or suffix. Language metadata belongs to the same captured manifest observation; legitimate missing adaptations retain existing fallback, while invalid selected binding is not absence. Trusted CLI/server composition supplies materialized format without a new public option or ambient configuration discovery inside the library. Legacy path-only APIs keep their bounded contract. This point-read slice does not complete page census, borrowed-page joins, build enumeration or self-citation validation, and claims neither source authentication nor global snapshot isolation.

p.SOURCE-DOC-GENERATED-LAW: Generated level-zero and failed-version pages enter the existing documentation rendering pipeline as explicit producer inputs, separate from authored package source admission. Reuse the existing page AST, card, projection, media and manifest assembly owners. Carry the actual subject coordinate and version, presentation metadata, known original package kind and existing relations; an unknown original kind remains unknown. A generated card is not a new package identity or authority to parse arbitrary authored roots. Do not invent a package kind, disguise the subject as a documentation package, or use a file marker or malformed synthetic manifest to bypass authored admission. Authored package reads retain strict manifest/source policy validation. The actual failed-fetch page and later successful retry must remain renderable, with existing projection and unknown-kind semantics. No new package kind, manifest/wire schema, second renderer or global source world follows from this distinction.

SOURCE-DOC-CENSUS.title: Selected documentation page inventories and consumers

p.SOURCE-DOC-CENSUS-LAW: Declared documentation page enumeration uses the actual Doc package, selected outer source policy and finite operation-owned native inventory. Shared selector precedence applies before filtering; a valid selector tie whose winning declarations are all outside the requested interpretation contributes no page, while a tie containing that native interpretation refuses. Structural manifest validation and unfiltered host inventory behavior remain unchanged. Ordinary resources and nested manifest data do not acquire page vocabulary. Authored originals use held policy/media/bytes, while installed roots require independent full selected lock identity/hash and trusted materialized format through the existing prepared record owner. Explicit roots are not replaced by nearer coordinate matches; an unbound materialized path cannot invent its own expectation. Preserve original logical relative paths and established document identities independently of converted filenames. Explicit empty has zero pages; malformed policy or unavailable selected input refuses. Native syntax failures remain named unreadable pages, and membership-only navigation can still name a malformed selected page. Actual build, server routes, self citations and borrowed examples consume the same selected inventory or point-read owners and retain relevant observation checks before publication or response. Server page selection uses logical document identity rather than reconstructing an xml filename; existing routes, translation relations and missing-page behavior remain compatible. Generated producer inputs retain their separate accepted boundary, and legacy APIs retain their qualified compatibility or explicit unsupported refusal where independent binding is absent. Reuse native Doc AST and existing rendering/manifest/projection owners; no new package kind, wire schema, source URI, parser, global source world or transaction is introduced.

SOURCE-LEVEL0-READ.title: Declared native inputs to generated level-zero views

p.SOURCE-LEVEL0-READ-LAW: Level-zero projection chooses authored native inputs through their declared interpretation and selected root, not a physical SPEC_ROOT existence gate or filename suffix. Parse VibeSpec as Spec; only an actual Doc package may supply Doc vocabulary. Do not disguise a project or other package kind as Doc. Use existing native inventory, selected Doc and generated rendering owners with the original identity and finite observations; an installed input still needs its independent binding or an explicit refusal. Retain captured native bytes for composition copies and relevant rechecks through publication instead of reopening authored files after capture. Existing card-only views may describe incomplete subject metadata without thereby authorizing authored native parsing. Ordinary resources enter only their existing explicitly selected literal presentation paths, never native page semantics by suffix. Preserve legacy layout, original logical names, canonical native meaning/status/void and the accepted generated-versus-authored boundary. No new kind, manifest/URI/wire schema, parser, global source world or transaction is introduced.
